CA.rationale: Content (red/blue positions) is explicitly bound to a processing/origin tag (command_estimate) for the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: The same current referent lists identified content (red/blue coordinates), an organization/presentation (coordinate sets across cells), and a separate origin/status field.

A.rationale: Processing/origin tags (e.g. command_estimate, inherited_current) are explicitly linked to specific candidate contents, indicating content-processing conditions affecting their presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report identifies represented contents (red and blue coordinate sets) for specific referents and times.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is presented separately from the identified content coordinates for the same referent/time, distinguishing content identity from representation status.

O.rationale: The content is presented as organized coordinate sets (grid cell groupings) under a named current referent, indicating how the content is organized/presented.
